notes: Editor, Customize (the proposal's C5): pointing at a layer, its plane in the stack, its section's header or its chip, outlines it on the copy: each card for Cards and Card options, the whole copy for the layers that cover it.

Editor, one control column (C3): every segment, menu, switch and slider in a section ends at the same right edge, and every slider's value sits in one column of one width after it (the sliders' tracks had ended a few pixels apart).
Editor, hints (C7): an open section's hint is an info mark beside its name instead of a line of text under it.
Editor, light motion (C9): a plane of the layer stack lifts as it is pointed at, and a section slides open as it opens; none when Windows asks for reduced motion.
